name: version_specifiers
title: Python Version and Specifier Management
summary: A capability to parse, compare, and validate PEP 440 compliant Python versions and requirement specifiers.

tools.name: parse_version
tools.description: Parses a version string into a structured Version object. Useful for normalizing and inspecting version components.

returns.name: normalized_version
returns.description: The normalized string representation of the version.

returns.name: epoch
returns.description: The epoch component of the version.

returns.name: release
returns.description: An array of integers representing the release part (e.0.g., [1, 2, 3]).

returns.name: is_prerelease
returns.description: Whether the version is a pre-release.

returns.name: is_postrelease
returns.description: Whether the version is a post-release.

returns.name: is_devrelease
returns.description: Whether the version is a development release.

returns.name: is_local
returns.description: Whether the version has a local identifier.

tools.implementation_notes: Instantiate `packaging.version.Version(version_string)`. Return the attributes `v.epoch`, `v.release`, `v.pre`, `v.post`, `v.dev`, `v.local` and `str(v)`. Note that `v.pre` is a tuple of (str, int) or None.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Compares two PEP 440 versions to determine their relative order.

params.name: version_a
params.description: The first version string to compare.

params.name: version_b
params.description: The second version string to compare.

returns.name: comparison_result
returns.description: A string describing the comparison result: 'less_than', 'less_than_or_equal', 'equal', 'equal_or_greater', 'equal_or_greater', 'greater_than', 'greater_than_or_equal', 'greater_than_or_equal' (Note: the agent should derive this from the boolean results of the comparison operators).

returns.name: comparison_details
returns.description: A human-readable string describing the comparison result.

tools.implementation_notes: Instantiate `packaging.version.Version(version_a)` and `packaging.version.Version(version_b)`. Use standard Python comparison operators: `v_a < v_b`, `v_a <= v_b`, `v_a == v_b`, `v_a >= v_b`, `v_a > v_b`. Return a string representation of the comparison outcome.

tools.name: check_version_matches_specifier
tools.description: Checks if a specific version satisfies a given requirement specifier (e.g., '>=1.0, <2.0').

returns.name: matches
returns.description: Whether the version satisfies the specifier.

returns.name: version_display
returns.description: The normalized version string used for comparison.

returns.name: specifier_display
returns.description: The specifier string used for comparison.

tools.implementation_notes: Instantiate `packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet(specifier_string)` and `packaging.version.Version(version_string)`. Use the `contains` method of the SpecifierSet (e.g., `specifier_set.contains(version_object)`).

uncertainties: The exact behavior of pre-release matching in SpecifierSet depends on the PEP 440 rules, which the agent should be aware of (e.g., pre-releases are only matched if the specifier explicitly includes a pre-release component).
